mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by >1% over the prior 3 months, or the 20d IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened labor market stress.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when both proxies decline simultaneously, or the IC exceeds 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), sustained increases in FEDFUNDS rates signal higher discount rates on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises for 3 consecutive months, or the IC is above 0.05 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 120 (historical level) indicates supply-side contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 120.0 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO drops below 120, or the IC is above 0.05 over the 5d window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent increases in PAYEMS (unemployment) above 130,000 suggest labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000 for 2 consecutive months, or the IC is above 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies increase simultaneously, or the IC is below 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE >5%), sustained elevated UNRATE levels predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days due to prolonged economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains above 5.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE stays above 5% for 3 months.
